title: Chapter 15 — AI Quiz: Software Development
instructions: Original AI-authored practice, not an official Cambridge or teacher paper. Answer all questions; written responses are self-marked using the guidance after submission. You can retake the quiz.
description: Original chapter practice: multiple-choice and written questions with self-marking guidance.

questions.text: Which test uses data at the boundary of an allowed range?
Which phase identifies user needs and requirements?
Explain the difference between testing and debugging.

answer.text: Testing finds faults by executing/checking the system.
Debugging locates and corrects the causes of faults.

questions.text: For an integer range 1 to 100 inclusive, give one normal and one invalid test value.

answer.text: Invalid: a value such as 0 or 101.

questions.text: State two reasons for producing technical documentation.

answer.text: Supports later maintenance, debugging or modification.

questions.text: Explain the difference between black-box and white-box testing.

answer.text: Black-box tests external behaviour against the specification without relying on internal code.
White-box uses knowledge of internal code or paths.
